'''''Valerianella''''' is a genus of [[flowering plant]] in family [[Caprifoliaceae]]. It includes 23 species native to the [[Mediterranean Basin]] of southern Europe and North Africa, western and central Asia, Madeira and the Azores, and Ethiopia and Kenya.<ref name = powo/> Many species formerly placed in ''Valerianella'', including those native to the [[Americas]], have been moved to ''[[Valeriana]]''.<ref>Christenhusz, M.J.M., M.F. Fay, and J.W. Byng, eds. 2018. ''The global flora: a practical guide to vascular plant species of the world''. Special edition, ''GLOVAP nomenclature'' Part 1, vol. 4: 1-155.</ref> Plants of ''Valerianella'' and ''Valeriana'' are sometimes known by the common name '''corn salad''' or '''cornsalad'''.
